# Luma (لوما)

> Luma (لوما) is a Persian-language artificial intelligence platform providing tools for image generation and editing, video creation and enhancement, speech synthesis, intelligent chat, virtual try-on, and visual workflow automation.

## What Luma Is

Luma is a web-based artificial intelligence platform designed for Persian-speaking creators, teams, and developers. It brings together generative and processing models in a unified interface for digital content creation and automation.

- Route: /
- Route: /about

## Main Capabilities

The platform provides creative artificial intelligence capabilities across multiple media modalities:

- Image Generation (ساخت تصویر): Creating images from text prompts using artificial intelligence models.
- Image Editing (ویرایش تصویر): Editing images with text instructions, including modifying parts and removing or replacing objects.
- Background Removal (حذف پس‌زمینه): Removing image backgrounds with one-click subject isolation.
- Image Upscaling (افزایش کیفیت تصویر): Improving image clarity, recovering details, and reducing noise.
- Video Generation (ساخت ویدیو): Generating videos from text and image prompts or reference video.
- Video Enhancement (افزایش کیفیت ویدئو): Enhancing video clarity and frame rate.
- Text-to-Speech (تبدیل متن به گفتار): Converting text to natural speech across multiple tones.
- Virtual Try-On (پوشاندن لباس): Virtual garment fitting on image models.
- Smart Chat (چت هوشمند): Conversational interaction with language models for text generation and inquiries.
- Smart Assistant (دستیار هوشمند): Conversational assistant answering inquiries based on provided documentation.
- Workflows (ورک‌فلوها): Visual canvas for designing and executing multi-step artificial intelligence processes.

## Services

Luma includes eleven core services verified in the platform:

- Image Generation (ساخت تصویر): خلق تصاویر با هوش مصنوعی. Route: /service/img-gen
- Image Editing (ویرایش تصویر): ویرایش هوشمند و تغییر بخش‌های تصویر. Route: /service/img-edit
- Background Removal (حذف پس‌زمینه): حذف دقیق و آنی پس‌زمینه تصاویر. Route: /service/bg-remove
- Smart Assistant (دستیار هوشمند): دستیار گفتگو و راهنمای شخصی. Route: /service/assistant
- Video Generation (ساخت ویدیو): تولید ویدیو از متن و تصویر. Route: /service/video
- Video Enhancement (افزایش کیفیت ویدئو): ارتقای کیفیت و وضوح ویدیو. Route: /service/video-enhancement
- Text-to-Speech (تبدیل متن به گفتار): تبدیل متن به صدای طبیعی با لحن‌های متنوع. Route: /service/text-to-speech
- Image Upscaling (افزایش کیفیت تصویر): ارتقای وضوح و جزئیات تصویر بدون افت کیفیت. Route: /service/upscale
- Virtual Try-On (پوشاندن لباس): پرو مجازی لباس بر روی مدل. Route: /service/try-on
- Smart Chat (چت هوشمند): گفتگو با مدل‌های زبانی پیشرفته. Route: /service/chat
- Workflows (ورک‌فلوها): طراحی فرآیندهای خودکار هوش مصنوعی در بوم بصری. Route: /service/workflow
- Services Catalog (خدمات و ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی): فهرست خدمات و ابزارهای پلتفرم. Route: /services

## Pricing and Subscription

Luma operates on a credit-based payment model:

- Current Payment Model: Users currently access services by charging and consuming LUM credits, without requiring a monthly subscription.
- Cost Transparency: The dashboard displays the cost before an operation is executed, which serves as the basis for credit deduction.
- Planned Subscriptions: Subscription plans described on the platform represent proposed or planned structures for future studio capacity, rather than an active payment requirement.
- Route: /pricing
- Route: /subscription

## Documentation and Tutorials

Luma provides educational and technical documentation:

- Technical Documentation: API references, guides, and model parameter descriptions. Route: /docs
- Tutorials: Practical guides demonstrating prompt crafting and workflow construction. Route: /tutorials
- Gallery: Visual showcase of images and videos generated with Luma AI tools, including prompt examples. Route: /gallery

The Luma blog serves as an educational and news resource:

- Topics: Articles on generative AI developments, prompting guidance, and platform tutorials.
- Dynamic Content: Articles and publications are loaded dynamically through the platform.
- Route: /blog
